aggregation.scope: Every regular file directly inside each completed arm directory; subdirectories and non-regular files are excluded.
aggregation.path_binding: The first-stage sha256sum records include each absolute file path beneath campaign_root. Consequently the aggregate binds both file bytes and the absolute campaign-root spelling.
aggregation.ordering: NUL-delimited absolute paths sorted bytewise with sort -z under LC_ALL=C.
aggregation.formula: LC_ALL=C find ARM_DIRECTORY -maxdepth 1 -type f -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum
aggregation.digest_field: The first whitespace-delimited field emitted by the final sha256sum.
